timezone: Asia/Shanghai; every timestamp serialized with an explicit UTC offset
core_question: Separate SIGNAL_TIME, ORDER_TIME, EXECUTION_TIME and EXECUTION_PRICE for the original closing-buy intent.
prohibited_assumption: Final T close, final-close RSI14 or final close-limit-up status cannot trigger an order filled at the same final T close.
recommendation_scope: Causal daily-data benchmark, not a final interpretation of the original same-close intent and not a production fill guarantee.

exchange_time_sources.regular_opening_auction: 09:15-09:25; session-specific exceptions and historical rule version must be checked
exchange_time_sources.regular_closing_auction: 14:57-15:00; orders may be submitted, cancellation is restricted; rule version and exceptional sessions must be checked

NEXT_SESSION_V1.signal_time: After the T daily bar and every required T input are finalized and available; event-time lower bound is the latest input available_at, not a date-only midnight marker.
NEXT_SESSION_V1.order_time: T+1 next exchange session from the frozen qualified trading calendar at 09:15:00+08:00 for a modeled opening-auction marketable-limit buy; never a T order.
NEXT_SESSION_V1.execution_time: T+1 opening auction at 09:25:00+08:00 if the conservative daily-data fill rule admits a modeled fill; otherwise no execution.
NEXT_SESSION_V1.execution_price: T+1 official unadjusted opening auction price from the frozen daily bar, observed only as an outcome after the auction; not a T signal input.
NEXT_SESSION_V1.fill_rule: MODELLED_FILL only if T+1 trading is allowed, pre-open DailyTradingConstraint is VALID and limit-applicable, an official positive opening price exists, and opening price is strictly below the validated upper limit. Opening exactly at the upper limit is NO_FILL. Invalid or absent price/constraint, suspension or non-trading is EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED. No automatic rollover to later sessions.
NEXT_SESSION_V1.slippage_assumption: 0 bps, explicitly idealized benchmark; no measured spread, latency, fees, impact or capacity claim
NEXT_SESSION_V1.limit_up_fill_assumption: No modeled buy fill at an opening limit-up; final T close at limit never proves a T fill.
NEXT_SESSION_V1.price_basis: Raw execution price; any later adjusted-price comparison must use one frozen decision anchor.
NEXT_SESSION_V1.known_limitation: A modeled open fill below the limit is not proof of an actual broker execution or available quantity. Portfolio sizing, fees and PnL remain out of scope.

CLOSING_AUCTION_V1.signal_time: Before the exchange-specific T closing-auction order cutoff, using only actually timestamped pre-order observations; final T close, final RSI and final close-limit status are forbidden inputs.
CLOSING_AUCTION_V1.order_time: T during the exchange closing-auction submission window, before its documented cutoff and subject to historical rule version.
CLOSING_AUCTION_V1.execution_time: T closing-auction match, only if order acceptance and queue/fill evidence support it.
CLOSING_AUCTION_V1.execution_price: Actual matched auction price only after independent auction/order evidence; a final daily close alone is insufficient.
unresolved_evidence: historical pre-order price/quote and provisional indicator inputs
available sell liquidity and queue position
historical coverage, units and publication timestamps
CLOSING_AUCTION_V1.limit_up_fill_assumption: EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED without matched liquidity/queue evidence; never assume 100% fill.

PRE_CLOSE_SNAPSHOT_V1.signal_time: A frozen intraday snapshot before the chosen exchange-specific order cutoff; 14:55 is a candidate, while 14:57 is an auction boundary, not an automatically valid data cutoff.
PRE_CLOSE_SNAPSHOT_V1.order_time: After the snapshot and before a documented T auction or continuous-session acceptance cutoff.
PRE_CLOSE_SNAPSHOT_V1.execution_time: T only if a separately evidenced order/fill model applies.
PRE_CLOSE_SNAPSHOT_V1.execution_price: Model-specific observed execution price, never substituted with the final daily close without auction evidence.
PRE_CLOSE_SNAPSHOT_V1.input_model: Latest observable price at cutoff plus finalized closes through T-1; provisional RSI/MA/limit state is a different strategy definition from final EOD.
unresolved_evidence: historical 1-minute or finer observations and their timestamp convention
auction submission timing and order acceptance
intraday limit-up path and fill feasibility

limit_up_execution.daily_data_same_day_limit_up_fill: NO_FILL for the conservative baseline or EXECUTION_UNRESOLVED for unqualified same-day policies; never assert an actual fill from close == limit_up
